item.title: The Real Reason Anne Frank Became a Global Symbol
item.description: Everyone knows Anne Frank: her face, her diary, her voice. item.title: Are Jewish-Americans Secret Traitors?
item.description: The charge of “dual loyalty” has followed Jews for centuries.
